notes.title: July Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Lots of exciting things have been happening over the past month! I just wanted to give yall a look into the awesome new content I've been adding to the game.
This month, the map of Hyelore has been completely revamped with new graphics and visuals:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/ba97c84f4b674c7e2da082d5b50f775a9a95aeb6.png[/img]

Each playable region as numbered above consists of 5 stage battles. Start your journey off in grassy hillsides and make your way through hot deserts and volcanoes. Enter the far reaches of abandoned lands and spooky catacombs. Traverse through ice, snow, and lush forests as you battle for victory!

We have also updated the visuals and functionality of towers. Here’s a list of towers available to you as you progress through the game. Each type of tower has its own unique projectile and damage indicator.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/14e82c8bc3c11fc2a7fad98704aaa4ca33535485.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/7e79e55da60a9c9d4e4beac47338f12f0fc96f0e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/85c88a17033d1c67639c5ff813e610a4a320909a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/a285774d0b160947d7da761f0a735dd07b46fb08.png[/img]

Shattered Isle (region 6) has been completely reworked. We have snowfalls, glistening ice effects and a cool winter fog surrounding this stage battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/6092488e40b8af2bd71dbb39f50d0da4d10e1a5e.png[/img]

Finally, we have a completely revamped Emerald Reach (region 7). You can see light rays penetrating through the lush forests and glowy wisps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/cb402b87eee37878b89f46c866945dd8cc3d73e4.png[/img]

If you think all of this looks awesome, definitely make sure to wishlist Tower Rush here on Steam! You can also join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nWZqZcGsPS]Discord[/url] to get more of a first look at things as I work on the game!

notes.title: June Dev Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Lots of exciting things have been happening over the past month! I just wanted to give yall a look into the awesome new content I've been adding to the game. 

The Arena has expanded several-fold with many new enhancements. There is now a dedicated experience bar just for levelling up in the Arena as shown in the gold strip below. Players are now able to earn Arena experience as they fight off endless waves of enemies. 

Earning half-bar and full-bar experience in the Arena will grant a player with treasures that they can collect in the new Treasure Hall menu. This means that two treasures are available to collect for every level that is gained!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/e2420b2436d4e307dbab9d040a5da9f864c90f4c.png[/img]

The Arena is expanding with the addition of events.  One such event, “Destroy the enemy banner” as seen below, pits you against the clock as you race to destroy a structure in the given time limit.  If successful, you are rewarded with one of many perks as you continue your Arena onslaught.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/00bf161e8eab870003bd21887c05ae59e8f1b936.png[/img]

The Treasure Hall offers various treasures and rewards, some of which are exclusive to it and cannot be found elsewhere in the game. Players can also test their luck with Wheel Spins and uncover greater rewards as they progress throughout the Arena. Here's a look at that are well as a few of the many rewards available in the Treasure Hall:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/a5da14f0147a693046b33bf2e8663f440498e894.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/2e5fe2ea19984c46214868019568b0616a8f901b.png[/img]

Wheel spins provide further unique rewards as well, such as new Arena weapons and experience boosts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/941b46be178a46c663de8985828d98f237077f57.png[/img]

Gold talents are now available in the Treasure Hall through opening chests or other means. As with other talent tiers, getting a gold talent will replace a lower-tier talent of the same kind. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/e753b21d1f4763fd0f846e79c0d9532dfb4e24f7.png[/img]

Lonely Lands (region 4) visuals and environment have been reworked. This area now contains smog, light rain particles and droplets that form on the ground. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/b13f1ecd19bfc33d7d13ddcaf11af9458677dfe4.png[/img]

Players now have an additional 4-slot stash where items can be placed as storage. Items can be stored, sold and swapped from stash but cannot exist in the Arena or stage battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/1c3968833e0dae1e06837b3452b7ba38f7f7d91f.png[/img]

The Bloom post-processing effect has been added to really give off a glowy and powerful aesthetic look to all the spells and many of the on-screen texts in the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/9b1306c950187b05dc352ed512a40c210428dbf3.png[/img]
The effect can be toggled in Settings, under Graphics.

If you think all of this looks awesome, definitely make sure to wishlist Tower Rush here on Steam! You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/nWZqZcGsPS]Discord[/url] to get more of a first look at things as I work on the game!

notes.title: v3.58 - Equippable Accessories for Guardians!
notes.content:
[h3]Guardians:[/h3]
- You can now equip Guardians with accessories earned from stage bosses!
- There are more than 45 accessories in the game, you will earn a random one (never a duplicate) after slaying a boss.
- As soon as you pick up an accessory it is saved. There is no need to defeat a Stage to keep the accessory you have found.
- Accesories take effect after equipping them in the Guardian menu, and only are effective while your Guardian is alive!
- Only ring accessories take effect in the Arena (other special accessories are effective in stage battles only).

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
- Slightly increased the overall spell damage of all bosses (roughly 10%).

[h3]Arena spoils:[/h3]
- Updated Arena spoils UI graphics.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed an issue causing 'not enough income' warning text to appear when attempting to use hotkeys 1 through 6 to upgrade unit recruits when those recruits were not available to the player.

notes.title: v3.51 Devlog - New units & new Guardian previews!
notes.content:
[h3]Bomber Elf[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Bomber Elf is a new artillery unit that is available to purchase during battle. 
[*]His goal, once recruited, is to lay mines at random locations on your side of the battle with the hopes that enemies would approach and detonate them. 
[*]The Bomber Elf is active for duty for a total of 15 seconds before retreating permanently. A new Bomber Elf must be recruited again to continue laying mines in battle.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/b7fe4411bbc9008f953a9d4386456f487bd181c8.png[/img]

[h3]New stage units[/h3]
During each threat wave, normal enemies will be accompanied by various guards which must be defeated to complete the stage. Guards vary in abilities and other stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/191457776f5ee02ddf6fcd1c58589d55c14157c4.png[/img]

[h3]New Guardian previews[/h3]
We have also included a sneak-peek at the new Guardians that will appear in the game in the near future. These new Guardians may cost gems to acquire or may need some other requirement to be unlocked and available to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127154/75a189a5b3765aceef87367c454575620b57ab02.png[/img]

notes.title: v 3.44 - Major UI updates and game balancing
notes.content:
I've gone to great lengths to completely update the UI of the game, and further the balancing of units as well. Below is a summary of all the changes made since the previous version.

[h3]UI:[/h3]
- Reworked entire game's UI and visual appeal.
- Updating loading bar graphic.
- Updated wave and enemy notification graphics.
- Updated enemy threat indicator graphics.
- Updated mouse cursor graphic.


[h3]Audio:[/h3]
- Normalized more menu component sounds.
- Updated sfx for enemy reinforcement notice.
- Updated sfx for menu hover items.

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
- Tweaked gold rate.
- Fixed volume of 'Toughen Up' and 'Divine Blessing' Favors.
- Fixed Stage 4 boss ability 'Winds of Change' to deal 6-10 damage per petal instead of 11-15.
- Fixed Stage 4 boss overlapping with units.
- Increased enemy wave reinforcement health, damage and armor by 25%.
- Updated Victory and Defeat UI screens with better transition and visual appeal.
- Ranged enemies will likely switch targets now to the closest unit hitting them.
- Increased the amount of gems gained after revisiting a previously beaten stage with diminishing returns.

[h3]Guardians:[/h3]
- Cost of Guardian abilities double with each rank increase.
- Fixed Castien's 'Frenzy' ability.
- Reduced Durheim cost to 4500 gold.

[h3]Units:[/h3]
- Conjurer ability 'Wailing Winds' has been increased from 3 winds to 4.

[h3]Unit Menu:[/h3]
- Fixed Influence meter gauge.
- Updated unit upgrade token costs.
- When upgrading units, the amount they are boosted is shown in teal under 'BOOST' column on the right.
- When upgrading units, upgrade prompt.
- Added upgrade transition bar animation.

[h3]Shop items:[/h3]
- Removed cyclone ability to pushback and added damage instead.
- Added level restrictions to shop items.

[h3]Start Screen:[/h3]
- Fixed visual effects from overlaying on top of changelog / settings.
- Fixed loading bar from not filling to full.

[h3]Talents:[/h3]
- Fixed wording of some talents related to support units.
- Reduced 'Let's Get Started' begin battle random rank I units automatically from 2/4 to 1/2.
- Reduced 'Meaty Bowmen' archer health gain from 20%/32% to 10%/17%.
- Reduced 'Precision' archer damage gain from 20%/40% to 10%/17%.
- Reduced 'Blessings Abound' support heals from 20%/35% to 15%/25%.
- Reduced 'Tanky Goodness' warrior health gain from 15%/25% to 10%/20%.
- Increased 'Enchanted Armor' armor gain from 1/3 to 2/4.
- Changed 'Weaken The Giants' from armor reduced by 4/7 to 10%/20%.
- Changed 'Overwhelming Fright' from armor reduced by 2/4 to 10%/20%.
- Increased 'Protective Will' armor gain from 1/3 to 2/4.
- Increased 'Panic Attack' attack speed from 7%/15% to 15%/30%.
- Increased 'Clarity Of Invocation' cast chance from 5%/10% to 10%/20%.
- Increased 'Wound Transfer' heal gain from 5%/15% to 25%/40%.

[h3]Guardian Menu:[/h3]
- Reduced some sound effect volume.

[h3]Home Screen:[/h3]
- Reduced drum roll sound heard during stage load.
- Reduced sound effect heard when selecting a reward Talent.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed Stage tutorials.
- Fixed Guardian cooldown image color.
- Changed Gold upgrade icon color.
- Changelog in-game will only display most recent changes.
- Fixed issue with unit upgrades being displayed after wiping game (new game).
- Increased Nomia's 'Ceremony of Light' ability cooldown from 16 to 20 seconds.
- Fixed issue with shop items showing level requirement when player level is higher or equal to item level.
- Fixed issue with unit upgrades pop-up menu blocking units.
- Moved unit upgrades pop-up menu to bottom right of screen.
- Increased reinforcements wave count for all stages.

notes.title: Catapults have entered battle!
notes.content:
[i]After suffering devastating amount of losses, the units had to regroup and formulate a new plan of attack. One that the enemy couldn't anticipate. 

For it wasn't a war of just swords, shields and magic any longer... there had to be a greater plan of attack. At the dawn of a new day, approaching in their glorious machinery, the call for help was heard. It's response: catapulting units to victory![/i]

[h3]Catapult behavior:[/h3]
- Catapults cost income to recruit just like normal units as indicated next to their icon.
- Catapults contribute to the unit cap limit.
- They have high armor and health. They deal low splash damage to enemies but very high damage to towers.
- They have a very large attack range, but will only engage in battle if there are units pushing ahead.
- If your forces are pushed back to your towers, catapults will not engage enemies until you begin pushing ahead.

[h3]Catapult types:[/h3]
- Rank 1 Catapult: Wooden Catapult. No ability.
- Rank 2 Catapult: Thrapper Catapult. 
Ability: Quick Fire. Releases a wave of rocks in rapid succession.
- Rank 3 Catapult: Spiked Catapult.  
Ability: Spike Smash. Charges forward at incredible speed, smashing into enemies and shooting spikes.

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
- Reduced XP gained from visiting previous levels slightly.
- You can now zoom in/out of battle using mouse scroll or keypad + / -. Arena mode does not have the zoom feature.
- Added loading screens. Tips will display periodically as the game loads.
- Added catapults to Tower Rush.
- Reworked the UI for stage battles. Hovering over units now displays their ability descriptions.
- Added option in Settings to disable unit descriptions pop-up when hovering on units.

Guardians:
- Improved Castien's 'Frenzy' ability damage.

[h3]Arena:[/h3]
- Reduced gold gain from killing enemies in Arena.
- Reduced the 'Bruiser' unit ability damage. (Unit that flies overhead and pounces down on an area).
- Enemies now display star-rating next to their health.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed Divine Herald ability 'Orb of Absorption' from having a permanent effect.
- Fixed Favor 'Quick Hire' from resetting previously earned unit upgrades.
- Fixed random issues with unit upgrades not taking effect.
- Fixed layering problems between units/enemies.

tags.feature: - Catapults cost income to recruit just like normal units as indicated next to their icon.
- Catapults contribute to the unit cap limit.
- They have high armor and health. They deal low splash damage to enemies but very high damage to towers.
- They have a very large attack range, but will only engage in battle if there are units pushing ahead.
- If your forces are pushed back to your towers, catapults will not engage enemies until you begin pushing ahead.
- Rank 1 Catapult: Wooden Catapult. No ability.
- Rank 2 Catapult: Thrapper Catapult. Ability: Quick Fire. Releases a wave of rocks in rapid succession.
- Rank 3 Catapult: Spiked Catapult. Ability: Spike Smash. Charges forward at incredible speed, smashing into enemies and shooting spikes.

tags.balance_change: - Reduced XP gained from visiting previous levels slightly.

tags.feature: - You can now zoom in/out of battle using mouse scroll or keypad + / -. Arena mode does not have the zoom feature.
- Added loading screens. Tips will display periodically as the game loads.
- Added catapults to Tower Rush.
- Reworked the UI for stage battles. Hovering over units now displays their ability descriptions.
- Added option in Settings to disable unit descriptions pop-up when hovering on units.

tags.balance_change: - Improved Castien's 'Frenzy' ability damage.
- Reduced gold gain from killing enemies in Arena.
- Reduced the 'Bruiser' unit ability damage. (Unit that flies overhead and pounces down on an area).

tags.feature: - Enemies now display star-rating next to their health.

tags.bug: - Fixed Divine Herald ability 'Orb of Absorption' from having a permanent effect.
- Fixed Favor 'Quick Hire' from resetting previously earned unit upgrades.
- Fixed random issues with unit upgrades not taking effect.
- Fixed layering problems between units/enemies.

notes.title: Added enemy ranks!
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
- Reworked enemy spawning functionality. Excluding bosses, enemies now may display a star rank next to their health that indicates if they have grown stronger during battle.
- At the start of each stage, most enemies will not have a star rank but as you progress and get closer to conquering towers, you will find that enemies will get stronger over time. 
- The longer a stage takes to win, the harder it may get to defeat it.

tags.feature: - Reworked enemy spawning functionality. Excluding bosses, enemies now may display a star rank next to their health that indicates if they have grown stronger during battle.

notes.title: Update v3.28
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
- Added counters for each class type that indicates how many of that type of class is alive in battle.

[h3]Gold Rate:[/h3]
- Increased income rate slightly for income ranks 2 to 10.
- Decreased income upgrade required for income ranks 2 to 10.

[h3]Units:[/h3]
- Increased Cleric hire cost from 15 to 17 gold.

[h3]Guardians:[/h3]
- Increased Durheim's unlock cost to 8000 gems.

[h3]Threats:[/h3]
- Threats now have knockback (similar to archer units).
- Increased armor of stage bosses 22 through 29.

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
- Slightly reduced income given from killing enemies. 

[h3]Threats (bosses):[/h3]
- Increased armor of all bosses slightly. 

[h3]Talents:[/h3]
- Fixed description of 'Jimmy Jangles' to mention spellcasters specifically.

[h3]Favors:[/h3]
- New Favor - Displace: 
Instantly send all enemies back to their towers.

- New Favor - Heavenly Sword: 
Send 10 magical swords from the sky to damage normal enemies for 35% of their health.

[h3]Unit Cap:[/h3]
- The further you upgrade your cap limit, the greater the increase:
- Cap Rank 1, 2, and 3 allow 3 extra units each.
- Cap Rank 4, 5, and 6 allow 4 extra units each.
- Cap Rank 7, 8, and 9 allow 5 extra units each.
- Cap Rank 10 allows 7 extra units, for a total of 45 units.

[h3]Hotfix:[/h3]
- Fixed leaderboards from being draggable.
- Lowered sensitivity on leaderboards to allow better scrolling with mouse wheel.

For full list of past updates, click [url=https://megaglope.com/patch-notes]here[/url].
